MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 5
   C. 13
   D. 4

2. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 43
   C. 41
   D. 31

6. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 122

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 9

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 1

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
